themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: The diplomatic and political fallout from Brazil's presidential election continues to reverberate internationally after defeated candidate Flávio Bolsonaro fled to the United States. Donald Trump granted sanctuary to Bolsonaro in the US despite money laundering investigations and travel bans in Brasilia, while Javier Milei's administration in Argentina faces political strain over reported intelligence assistance during the escape.

countries.note: Donald Trump authorized an entry visa and welcomed Bolsonaro to remain in the US indefinitely, defending the decision.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across Europe and the Americas are raising alarms over what they frame as weaponized judicial systems and state interference. In Poland, PiS and President Nawrocki clash with the government over police action at the Constitutional Tribunal, while Marine Le Pen in France faces judicial rulings on her 2027 eligibility while condemning Warsaw's court crackdown.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Western and Northern Europe are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and demanding national priority policies. Vox in Spain frames border arrivals in Ceuta as an institutional disaster, while the AfD in Germany pushes restrictive asylum labor rules and Sweden Democrats debate national identity and assimilation.

countries.note: Faces internal ideological friction over biological versus cultural definitions of Swedish national identity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Links economic grievances to border security as British right-wing activists are detained in France for anti-migrant operations.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist right movements across multiple continents are gearing up for key electoral contests with campaign launches, mass rallies, and aggressive polling strategies. From Donald Trump's final midterm rally push in the US to Marine Le Pen launching her 2027 presidential bid in France and Vox building campaign momentum in Spain, right-wing leaders claim growing public support.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in government and coalition negotiations are experiencing heightened internal strain over foreign policy alignments, media outreach, and power-sharing terms. In Italy, Matteo Salvini's Lega signals divergent views on Ukraine aid and bank taxes, while Sweden Democrats face internal split reports regarding coalition compromises with center parties.
